QuestInfo.name: The Cave's Password
QuestInfo.0: This is your fourth assignment as an informant. You discovered the Puppeteer's Cave, but it's sealed with a password. \r\n\r\nTalk to #b#p1040002##k in #b#m101030000##k. He's as likely as anyone to know something.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1040002# overheard the password with his mega ears! But he requested #b30 #t4000007#s#k in exchange for his help.
It's such a weird request from a cat. 

#i4000007# #t4000007# #b#c4000007# / 30#k
QuestInfo.2: #p1040002# gave you the password. It is #r'Francis is a genius puppeteer!'#k All the words in the password have to be exact, including the capitalization and spacing, so be careful.

0.2: Where are your manners? Do you not know anything about fair trade? You're not getting a single clue until you until you go hunt #o2230100#s and bring me #b30 #t4000007#s#k!
